title: Elysion Calendar
subtitle: Find a karaoke room, without the tab shuffle
description: A room-availability calendar for Elysion karaoke. Compare rooms and half-hour slots in daily and weekly views, using the shop’s official booking data.
longDescription: A small web app that reads Elysion’s official booking page and presents private karaoke-room availability as room cards, a daily timetable and a weekly overview. Mobile layouts and Taiwan-time slot handling make it easier to find a free room.
features: Room cards, daily timetable and weekly availability
Official booking-page data with background caching
Taiwan-time handling for past and current slots
results: Room availability organised around the shop’s booking data
